name: What information should I provide to my car accident attorney?
description: Provide your attorney with the police report, insurance details, photos, witness contacts, and all medical records related to your injuries.

mainEntity.name: What information should I provide to my car accident attorney?

acceptedAnswer.text: When meeting with a car accident attorney, bring all documentation related to your crash. This includes the police report, insurance information for all parties involved, photos of the accident scene and vehicle damage, contact details for witnesses, and any medical records or bills related to your injuries. Detailed information helps your attorney build a strong case.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide your attorney with the police report, insurance details, photos, witness contacts, and all medical records related to your injuries.
